gold_rules: LANDS iff on the OUTER-skin apex of a real formed fold, parallel, >= 80% of the visible fold; joggle = 2 bends; formed bends >= 15 deg count; window/relief-interrupted fold of the same two plates = ONE line; hole walls, thickness/perimeter edges, embosses, gentle rolled kinks, artifacts are not bends; staged scans: label only bends formed in that scan; zero-bend scans are valid gold.
